title: Whole-system open adjunction Hom-transpose normalization
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, a finite-field datum D with ell a specified unit in D.k, and a quasi-compact open immersion j:U -> X over D.k, with X separated finite type and U finite type, using the residue-field inverse structures and the exact completed coefficient data of [def-sf-integral-support-normalization-data]. Write F for the specified integral compact-support functor for (j,id), R for the specified constructible integral pullback, and d for inverse compact-support realization followed by section-normalized openIdentity. There is a natural isomorphism p from R followed by inclusion to inclusion followed by ordinaryOpenPull. Let a:F ⊣ R be the ordinary open adjunction restricted using exactly d and p. For every N,K and f:F(N) -> K, the reduction of f to the entire strict quotient system is the composite of compactOperationReduction(N), systemDirectId, and the inverse system-open Hom transpose of the reduction of a.homEquiv(f) followed by the actual integralComparisonPullbackCounit(K). This asserts only the normalized pullback comparison and compatibility of Hom transposes; it contains no completeness, interval, finite reduction, shift, or triangulated conclusion.

proof.text: Use integralOpenReductionComparison on the actual open slice. Identify its completed and strict-system open functors with the recorded ordinary and system functors through the section-normalized coefficient maps and uniqueness of adjoints. Its system unit and counit identities imply the Hom-transpose identity: on one simultaneous flat-term K-flat quotient representative both transposes are x -> x tensor 1. The quotient transitions preserve this equality, so it descends through exact localization as an equality of entire derived system morphisms, before evaluation.

proof.text: The normalized compact-support realization for (j,id) uses the same quotient augmentations. Removing the identity factor by its section-normalized right-adjoint identity gives precisely compactOperationReduction followed by systemDirectId. Restrict the ordinary adjunction by the full inclusions using d and p, and apply its Hom bijection to f. The previous whole-system equality becomes the stated formula. Identity and empty opens and zero inputs follow from the same adjunction triangles, without faithfulness of evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem openAdjunctionTransposeNormalization (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (primeUnit : IsUnit (l : D.k))
    {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [U.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ x : U, Invertible (l : U.residueField x)]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    [j.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] :
    let d := (sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization l E D.k primeUnit
      (Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion j)).symm ≪≫
        isoWhiskerLeft (sfIntegralConstructible l E U).ι (openIdentity l E j)
    ∃ p : constructibleIntegralPullback l E j ⋙ (sfIntegralConstructible l E U).ι ≅
        (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ ordinaryOpenPull l E j,
      let a := (ordinaryOpenAdjunction l E j).restrictFullyFaithful
        (sfIntegralConstructible l E U).fullyFaithfulι
        (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).fullyFaithfulι d.symm p.symm
      ∀ (N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E U)
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
        (f : (sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l D.k primeUnit
          (Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion j) E).obj N ⟶ K),
        (FrobeniusExchange.reduction l E X).map f.hom =
          ((FrobeniusExchange.compactOperationReduction l E D.k primeUnit j
            (Compactification.ofIsOpenImmersion j)).app N ≫
            (systemDirectId l E X).hom.app
              ((FrobeniusExchange.systemDerivedOpen l E j).obj
                ((FrobeniusExchange.reduction l E U).obj N.obj))) ≫
          ((FrobeniusExchange.systemDerivedOpenAdjunction l E j).homEquiv _ _).symm
            ((FrobeniusExchange.reduction l E U).map ((a.homEquiv N K) f).hom ≫
              (integralComparisonPullbackCounit l E j
                ((FrobeniusExchange.models l E).system X)
                ((FrobeniusExchange.models l E).system U)
                ((FrobeniusExchange.models l E).roos U)
                ((FrobeniusExchange.models l E).pullback j)).app K.obj)
